accepted_statement: For every prime q>5, N=5q, every primitive Nth root zeta, and every arbitrary binary N-by-N R, the fixed-phase matrix D[r,c]=R[r,c]*zeta^(r*c) cannot have D*D=dI or DD*=dI at d in {2q,3q,4q}.
model: R binary N by N; zeta any primitive Nth root; original fixed Fourier phases; either positive square scalar Gram implies both.
